svg.title: DMMB version 2 model buffer file format
svg.desc: A 36-byte header and N 28-byte mesh range descriptors precede aligned vertex and index payloads. Magic is char[4]; numeric header and descriptor fields are little-endian uint32_t. Vertex attributes are float32, and draw indices are uint16_t or uint32_t. Static vertices use 72 bytes and skinned vertices 104 bytes.
svg.text: .modelbuffersc · GPU-ready geometry shared by model resources
Stored order · schematic, not to scale
28 bytes · descriptor i at file offset 36 + 28 × i
f32 = float32 · array lengths shown in brackets
Vertex ranges: 16 bytes. Index ranges: 4 bytes. Range padding counts toward payload sizes.
Each mesh’s buffer_index selects a descriptor; offsets address the same shared GPU buffers.
